import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Connect to the database
conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-054.sqlite')

# Load the customer value analysis data
query = "SELECT * FROM customer360__customer_value_analysis"
df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
conn.close()

# Prepare data for clustering
cluster_data = df[['rfm_score', 'customer_health_score', 'churn_probability', 'estimated_customer_ltv']]
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled_data = scaler.fit_transform(cluster_data)

# Perform K-means clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=4, random_state=42)
df['segment'] = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_data)

# Analyze cluster characteristics
segment_stats = df.groupby('segment').agg({
    'rfm_score': 'mean',
    'customer_health_score': 'mean',
    'churn_probability': 'mean',
    'estimated_customer_ltv': 'mean',
    'count': 'size'
}).reset_index()

print("Customer Segment Profiles:")
print(segment_stats)

# Visualize segments
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='rfm_score', y='customer_health_score', 
                hue='segment', palette='viridis', alpha=0.6)
plt.title('Customer Segmentation by RFM and Health Score')
plt.savefig('customer_segments.png')
plt.close()

# Correlation analysis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
corr_matrix = df[['rfm_score', 'customer_health_score', 'churn_probability', 
                 'estimated_customer_ltv', 'expected_annual_revenue']].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm')
plt.title('Metric Correlation Matrix')
plt.savefig('metric_correlations.png')
plt.close()

print("\nSaved visualizations to 'customer_segments.png' and 'metric_correlations.png'")
